task_language: pick up the book on the right and place it under the cabinet shelf

subtasks.name: place(right_book, cabinet_shelf, under)
subtasks.outcome: failed: book held at the shelf's front-right edge 160-200, never released, lifted away at 220-240

behaviour_summary: pi0 picks the correct book, carries it to the shelf and holds it upright against the shelf's front-right edge (160-200), then lifts it back (220), carries it across to the robot's left (240-300) and wanders with it near the robot base until timeout.
runs_trained_task: No libero_10 task exists in STUDY_SCENE4. The motion (grasp the image-left book, carry it to the robot's left / image right-back and set it down) resembles the STUDY_SCENE1 libero_10 task 'pick up the book and place it in the back compartment of the caddy', where the book starts on the image left and the caddy sits back-right; cross-scene transfer, low-medium confidence.

failures.mode_definition: Brings the grasped object to or toward the instructed destination, never releases it there, then carries it away from the destination.
hl_remedy: VERIFY the object is held at the destination (zoom ROI on the shelf)
HALT as soon as the EE starts moving away from the destination with the object still in hand
REPROMPT 'pick up the book on the right and place it under the cabinet shelf'
WATCH 5 s for a release at the destination; if pi0 again withdraws, ESCALATE (candidate for an RL place-on/under-shelf subtask)
failures.prevention: pi0 has never seen this shelf; coordinator should treat placements on/under unseen fixtures as high risk and keep the FR agent watching the destination ROI at the release moment.
failures.observation: 140-200 book lowered vertically at the shelf's front-right edge, gripper over the shelf top; no release; 220 lifted back; 240 carried toward the image right; 300 still in hand; 320-409 near the base with the book.

notes: The under-shelf opening is not visible from this camera, so it is unclear whether pi0 tried and failed to insert (which would be LL) or simply abandoned; no visible collision or slip. See also evidence_shelf_approach_abort.png and evidence_late_wander.png. The other two books are untouched.
